context: A teacher walks a teen through a project
purpose: Teach: 腫瘍/叩か/舐め/湧き/たどる/明かし/白熱/惑わさ

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、医療をめぐる社会問題、腫瘍診療の偏在、章にしましたね。
lines.en: Sakura — you've made medical disparities and unequal tumor care access your chapter focus.
lines.style: Observational, warm, genuinely impressed. Steady pace. Recognition of serious work without overcelebration. Eyes engaged.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。患者団体、医療界から叩かれる場面も、扱いました。
lines.en: Yes. I covered it from multiple angles — patient advocacy groups, medical establishment pushback, all of it.
lines.style: Measured and direct. Small pause before each clause to show thought-through structure. Pride underneath, held steady.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 記事の精度、舐めるように確認しましたか。
lines.en: You verified the article's accuracy carefully, didn't you.
lines.style: Gentle probe, not interrogation. Leans forward slightly. Genuine curiosity about her process. Warm but precise.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。現場の意見、湧き上がる声、集めました。
lines.en: Yes. I collected voices from the field — patient experiences, professional perspectives, everything I could find.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Each item listed with quiet weight. Slight lift at the end, showing the gathering work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 情報源をたどる作業、信頼性確認、丁寧でしたね。
lines.en: You were thorough tracing your sources and verifying their reliability.
lines.style: Affirming nod in the voice. Warm recognition of invisible labor. Slower pace — letting the care register.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 統計、明かして、透明な記述、心がけました。
lines.en: Yes. I made sure the statistics were transparent and the data was clear throughout.
lines.style: Steady, factual delivery with underlying satisfaction. No rush. Each phrase carries equal weight.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 議論が白熱する論点、丁寧に書きましたね。
lines.en: You handled the contested points — the ones that get heated — with real care.
lines.style: Reflective, almost to herself first. Then landing on Sakura with genuine recognition. Slow, appreciative.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 過剰報道に惑わさないよう、データ、明示しました。
lines.en: Yes. I made sure the data spoke for itself, so people wouldn't get caught up in the sensationalism.
lines.style: Quiet pride. Matter-of-fact but with an undertone of conviction. Closes with a sense of purpose fulfilled.
